reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount helpers like the other providers, and the balance branch is shared with Akahu, but the transaction download copies Akahu's function instead of sharing it.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions differing only in the server URL and log text.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, URL in server-config and type in types/models, all where the tree keeps each provider's pieces.

scope.why: Only the Fintegra provider wiring, its types and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: The link path follows the shared pattern cleanly; the copied download function is a second place to fix for any change to the standard transactions endpoint.
